channel.title: Sandeep Pawar
channel.description: Writing for students, professionals and founders.

item.title: Sample: Choosing between two job offers
item.description: Salary is the easiest thing to compare and usually the least important difference between two offers early in a career.

item.title: Sample: How to ask your manager for feedback
item.description: “Any feedback for me?” almost always gets “You’re doing fine.” A narrower question gets an answer you can use.

item.title: Sample: Your first ninety days at work
item.description: The first three months set how people see you for a long time. Spend them learning how the place works, not proving how much you know.
